title: Critical slowing down in the Sherrington–Kirkpatrick model
summary: At the critical inverse temperature β = 1, we prove slow mixing for zero-field Gaussian Sherrington–Kirkpatrick heat-bath dynamics from typical equilibrium configurations held fixed as initial states. For every deterministic sequence $`t_n=o(n^{2/3})`$ in rate-one-per-site time, the Gibbs mass of initial states whose time- t n total-variation distance from equilibrium exceeds 1/4 tends to one in probability over the disorder. The same statement holds for every deterministic integer sequence $`k_n=o(n^{5/3})`$ of uniform-site update attempts.
family_title: Critical SK autocorrelation processes and dynamics across the temperature transition

review.reason: Proves slow mixing of SK heat-bath dynamics from typical equilibrium initial states at criticality.
